slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: A before/after benchmark on 3-5 real project tasks shows the final setup beating the bare install on tokens, wall-clock, or correctness…
The ablation table shows stale/over-instruction rules removed without hurting the score, and every retained rule/skill justified by a delta or a safety reason.
